name: qlrisk_credit_risk
title: Credit risk measures
description: Credit-risk calculators: pd (probability of default: structural Merton, reduced form, rating transition matrix, logistic, historical), lgd (fixed, collateral, workout, market, stochastic), ead, el (expected loss = PD x LGD x EAD), economic_capital (Vasicek, Gordy, Monte Carlo; also EL, VaR and ES of the loss distribution) and raroc (risk-adjusted return on capital vs a hurdle). Fields per measure: pd: asset_value (['number', 'null']); debt_value (['number', 'null']); asset_volatility (['number', 'null']); risk_free_rate (['number', 'null']); time_horizon (number, default 1.0); hazard_rate (['number', 'null']); credit_rating (['string', 'null']); rating_pd (['number', 'null']); financial_ratios (object); model_coefficients (object). lgd: exposure (number, default 0.0); recovery_rate (['number', 'null']); collateral (array); recovery_history (array); bond_price (['number', 'null']); lgd_mean (['number', 'null']); lgd_std (['number', 'null']); is_senior (boolean, default True); is_secured (boolean, default False). ead: current_exposure (number, required); notional (number, required); credit_conversion_factor (number, default 1.0); add_on_factor (number, default 0.0); collateral_value (number, default 0.0); collateral_haircut (number, default 0.0); netting_benefit (number, default 0.0); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 0.03968253968253968); replacement_cost (['number', 'null']); pfe_add_on (['number', 'null']). el: pd (number, required); lgd (['number', 'null']); ead (number, default 0.0); time_horizon (number, default 1.0); maturity (['number', 'null']); recovery_rate (['number', 'null']); pd_term_structure (array); time_points (array). economic_capital: exposures (array, required); pds (array, required); lgds (array, required); asset_correlation (number, default 0.2); correlation_matrix (array); ead (['number', 'null']); pd (['number', 'null']); lgd (['number', 'null']); confidence_level (number, default 0.999); time_horizon (number, default 1.0). raroc: revenue (number, required); fee_income (number, default 0.0); spread_income (number, default 0.0); trading_income (number, default 0.0); operating_cost (number, default 0.0); funding_cost (number, default 0.0); hedging_cost (number, default 0.0); expected_loss (number, default 0.0); economic_capital (number, default 0.0); regulatory_capital (number, default 0.0); cva (number, default 0.0); fva (number, default 0.0); kva (number, default 0.0); tax_rate (number, default 0.25); hurdle_rate (['number', 'null']). Config: pd: model (structural|reduced_form|transition_matrix|logistic|historical), time_horizon; lgd: model (fixed|collateral|workout|market|stochastic), default_lgd, floor, cap; ead: method (cem|imm|sa_ccr), alpha, include_margin; el: time_horizon, annualize, use_term_structure; economic_capital: method (gordy|monte_carlo|vasicek), confidence_level, num_simulations; raroc: hurdle_rate, include_xva, use_regulatory_capital. Inputs: measure, inputs, config. Inputs: measure, inputs, config. Example: {"measure": "el", "inputs": {"pd": 0.02, "lgd": 0.45, "ead": 1000000}} gives EL: 9,000.00.
